digest.component_or_area: bridge pause/resume gate format and reconciliation workflow
propositions: dual-format gate blob must retain both gated_mode reconcile-check and paused metadata fields for backward compatibility with old readers
pause operation must be idempotent when reason is unchanged and reject with refusal when reason differs, identity is missing, remote is missing, or CAS conflicts occur
pause must block before lock acquisition and ticket mutation, return rc 0 with exact anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker, and cause workflow to skip commit-and-push only on that marker
resume must delete only the observed ref OID via CAS and safely recover corrupt blobs without decoding or traceback
legacy reconcile-check early return and rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary must remain functional and unmodified
corrupt blob state must return rc 1 with clean recovery message without traceback, while legacy gate rc 4 and ordinary rc 0 retain existing behavior
